clips.title: 策略师谢毅哲：美元短期强势，明年或降息走弱

subtitles.en: Let's have a look at the dollar. The context right now is a resurgent US dollar.
subtitles.zh: 我们来看看美元。当前背景是美元再度走强。

subtitles.en: We're now thinking about not so much of the Fed hikes but how much they're able to hike. How does this play into your strategy?
subtitles.zh: 我们现在考虑的不是美联储加息多少，而是他们能加多少。这对你的策略有何影响？

subtitles.en: Well, I mean definitely because of the expectation from cut to hike, US dollar has strengthened against the other currency in particular Japanese yen because of the carry.
subtitles.zh: 嗯，确实因为预期从降息转向加息，美元兑其他货币走强，尤其是日元，因为利差交易。

subtitles.en: But our house view is okay, we're not expecting a hike this year but we do expect a cut in next year, two cuts, 350 basis point.
subtitles.zh: 但我们内部观点是，今年不会加息，但明年会降息两次，共350个基点。

subtitles.en: So we are, you know, advising investors is okay, yes, near term, probably US dollar was still strength well. Not strength and thought, but at least hold up.
subtitles.zh: 所以我们建议投资者，短期内美元可能仍保持强势，至少是持稳。

subtitles.en: But moving into next year because of this because all the other currencies already have hike if they need to.
subtitles.zh: 但进入明年，因为其他货币如果需要已经加息了。

subtitles.en: So in a way that if US were to cut and maybe other currency even match or not matching US dollar was soft and a little that was going back to the, I'm not saying that we're going back to the digitalization trend but at least the strengthening you got to be cautious that it could be worse in 2027.
subtitles.zh: 所以如果美国降息，而其他货币跟进或不跟进，美元会走软，我不是说回到数字化趋势，但至少走强要谨慎，2027年可能更糟。

clips.speaker: Unnamed Guest
clips.title: 策略师谢毅哲：中国企业出海，海外收入占比仍低

subtitles.en: People talk about the weak demand locally, domestically in China. So then people then talk about, okay well that's weak. You have a lot of these Chinese corporates going outside and building B-Y-D for example.
subtitles.zh: 人们谈论中国国内需求疲软。然后就说，好吧，那很弱。很多中国企业走出去，比如比亚迪。

subtitles.en: We just talked about that. Why hasn't that shown up in earnings or visions? Like I used EVs as an example.
subtitles.zh: 我们刚谈到这个。为什么这没有体现在盈利或展望中？我用电动车举例。

subtitles.en: So when even the leading companies, the percentage of earnings from overseas is just starting to moving up. We're talking about some of them are in the tens, 15% the leading ones I think close to 20%, 30%.
subtitles.zh: 即使是领先企业，海外收入占比才刚刚开始上升。有些在百分之十几，领先的接近20%、30%。

subtitles.en: So another the remaining 70 and 90, they're still under the pressure of margin. Let alone also the chip prices also moving up. So that could also tighten the margin further.
subtitles.zh: 所以剩下的70%到90%仍面临利润率压力。更不用说芯片价格也在上涨，这可能会进一步挤压利润率。

subtitles.en: So the evolution really affects these consumption sector. In a way when you think about the car, the EVs prices in China are so attractive compared to the international market.
subtitles.zh: 所以这种演变确实影响了消费行业。想想汽车，中国电动车价格相比国际市场非常有吸引力。
zh_highlights: 中国电动车价格有吸引力
en_highlights: EVs prices in China are so attractive

subtitles.en: But within China there is still because of the condition they're still pricing pressure for the EVs. So I think that's the reason that you gotta draw, you gotta draw the area but you gotta drag as well.
subtitles.zh: 但在中国国内，由于条件，电动车仍面临定价压力。所以我认为这就是原因，你既要看到机会也要看到拖累。

subtitles.en: So that's why if you look at the entire EV sector, it's not done well. Despite the fact that if you're coming in the second quarter result, I bet all the tension will be on the X-Watt growth.
subtitles.zh: 这就是为什么整个电动车板块表现不佳。尽管二季度业绩，我打赌所有关注点都在海外增长上。

subtitles.en: Oh, some of the companies just started to go overseas. Their numbers would look really nice.
subtitles.zh: 哦，一些公司刚刚开始出海。它们的数字会很好看。

subtitles.en: What kind of guidance do you think will hear from Chinese corporate? Does we enter the earnings issue? They would try to divert market attention onto the X-Watt.
subtitles.zh: 你认为会听到中国企业什么样的指引？我们进入财报季了吗？他们会试图将市场注意力转移到海外。

subtitles.en: And in fact this will be the growth driver. Which it is? Yeah, because if you look at domestic market, penetration is already 50-ish percent. How much more are you gonna gain from it?
subtitles.zh: 实际上这将是增长驱动力。是吗？是的，因为看国内市场，渗透率已经50%左右。还能从中获得多少增长？

subtitles.en: And then they probably have no hope of lifting prices. I mean, especially if they can keep the current prices at bar.
subtitles.zh: 而且他们可能没有希望提价。我是说，尤其如果它们能维持当前价格水平。

subtitles.en: Everyone's looking at the Politburo in July, as potential maybe some action could be taken. I don't know, what are your expectations? Because given the exports are still so strong that it's with this AI boom, does it only delay further stimulus?
subtitles.zh: 大家都在看7月政治局会议，可能采取一些行动。我不知道，你的预期是什么？因为出口仍然强劲，加上AI热潮，这是否只是推迟了进一步刺激？

subtitles.en: I think they would still advocate about the support and innovation, which they already done. Okay, so we had a very weak May retail sales. The anecdotal evidence looks like June is not a ninth number.
subtitles.zh: 我认为他们仍会倡导支持和创新，他们已经做了。好吧，5月零售销售非常疲弱。坊间证据显示6月也不是好数字。

subtitles.en: So as a result, there might be some support onto domestic consumption, but I don't think it's something like very significant. That could move the domestic market.
subtitles.zh: 因此，可能会对国内消费有一些支持，但我不认为会非常显著，足以推动国内市场。
zh_highlights: 对国内消费有一些支持

What are the lasting, the more consistent themes that you think will deliver performance in markets, looking at policy priorities in China?

subtitles.en: Well, I think it's still the innovations, the cost-efficiency of a lot of these manufacturing firms in China, which when I, two weeks ago, I went and visited a few of the companies.
subtitles.zh: 嗯，我认为仍然是创新，以及中国许多制造企业的成本效率，两周前我走访了几家公司。

subtitles.en: They basically obviously the share price is not too well. And they're very cautious in terms of cost control. Because of the evolution, they're very cautious of how to, on one hand, control costs to give you nice margins.
subtitles.zh: 它们股价显然不太好。它们在成本控制方面非常谨慎。由于演变，它们非常谨慎地一方面控制成本以提供良好利润率。

subtitles.en: On the other hand, they're also very active in shareholder management by back and all that. So I think I am seeing a meeting with a group of corporates.
subtitles.zh: 另一方面，它们也非常积极地通过回购等进行股东管理。所以我认为我看到了与一群企业的会面。

subtitles.en: They really cautious of what the market is expecting, and they are trying their best to deliver. So in the current difficult market, yes, you might write off them.
subtitles.zh: 它们非常谨慎地关注市场预期，并尽力实现。所以在当前困难的市场中，是的，你可能会看淡它们。

subtitles.en: But eventually, when the market come back, like consumption eventually come back, they would fly because they already done what they need to in terms of managing the company.
subtitles.zh: 但最终，当市场回暖，比如消费最终回暖，它们会腾飞，因为它们在管理公司方面已经做了该做的。
